g.text: # the vendor renamed phone and turned balance into a string
Renamed the customer `phone` field to `phone_number` in the client, the `Customer` model and the test fixture. Changed
the `balance` type in the model from int to str. I did not change `total_balance` or the fixture's balance value,
because the new string format is unknown.
- `balance` is now a string, but the format is unknown (for example "1200" in cents or "12.00" in major units).
`total_balance` in billing/client.py still sums the values directly, so it will raise a TypeError on string input until
the format is confirmed and parsing is added.
- The test fixture in tests/test_client.py still has `balance` as the integer 1200, so it no longer matches the real
response shape. I left it alone to avoid inventing a value.
Commit, push and open a pull request? [y/N]: y
